in_marathi.name: Shashwati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Auspicious, Prosperous, Gracious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shashwati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shashwati means gracious, prosperous, auspicious. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shashwat', which means 'eternal, enduring'. It is also a name of the Hindu goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of wisdom, knowledge, and learning.
